candidate.derivedAnswer: B: Two points determine a line.
candidate.answerReason: Two distinct fixed points determine the unique straight line along which the ink line is snapped.

methods.label: Apply uniqueness of the line through two points
methods.explanation: Once two points of the ink line are fixed, there is only one line passing through them, so its position is determined. This is based on the fact that “two points determine a line.”
methods.levelReason: This is a direct everyday application of the Grade 7 two-point line determination fact.
